title: Conclusion: From Prompt Engineering to Story Engineering
use_cases: Use when architecting long-form fiction systems beyond simple text generation
Implement when maintaining narrative consistency over large token windows
Configure when requiring a structured state management engine for AI agents
Implement when applying engineering disciplines like iterative critique to creative writing
Use when markdown-based artifacts are needed as a persistent source of truth
content:
We started thinking we were building a text generation tool. We ended up building a state management engine.

The key shift was this: long-form fiction isn’t “just more tokens.” It’s a system with rules, memory, and contracts. By introducing markdown-based Artifacts as a Source of Truth, using Checkpoints as explicit targets, decomposing outlining into layered passes, and drafting with rolling memory plus iterative critique loops, we can generate longer narratives with substantially improved consistency.

It won’t work for every story. It won’t prevent every failure.But it turns long-form generation from a one-shot gamble into an engineering discipline built on repeatable steps, checks, and continuous improvement.
